episodes.196575: Onshore-moving showers produced gusty winds along the Brevard County Coast.
episodes.197221: A waterspout was observed southwest of Key West as result of an outflow-driven cluster of showers moving west-southwest off the mainland of the Florida Peninsula interacting with a developing convective cloud line over the Lower Florida Keys.

events.county: Hawk Channel From West End Of Seven Mile Bridge To Halfmoon Shoal Out To The Reef
events.narrative: A long-duration waterspout was observed via NWS Florida Keys rooftop camera about three to four miles south-southwest of Key West.  The waterspout appeared tilted throughout its lifespan, was generally skinny, with the condensation cloud extending about one-fifth the way from cloud base to the horizon.
